content: qmd CHANGELOG (primary, raw.githubusercontent.com/tobi/qmd/main): latest release 2.8.3 (2026-08-16). [Unreleased] adds opt-in namespaced frontmatter qmd.metadata (strings/numbers/booleans/flat homogeneous arrays; nested/null/empty/mixed rejected) + recursive filter AST discriminated by operator: and/or/not, eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte, in/nin/all, contains/prefix/suffix, type, exists, optional caseInsensitive (ASCII fold). Applied BEFORE RRF fusion and reranking; highly selective filters best-effort for top-K completeness. Surfaces: CLI search/vsearch/query --filter <json>, SDK filter option, MCP query tool, HTTP POST /query,/search. Metadata discovery: qmd collection metadata (--filter/--match/--key-limit/--key-offset/--all-keys/--value-limit/--value-offset/--all-values/--sort count|value/--min-count), SDK listMetadata, MCP metadata tool, HTTP POST /metadata; stats = keys/types/doc-counts, numeric min/median/max, mixed types split per type, exact remainders. file_sync_state mtime+size fast path: unchanged reindex seconds; 20k-file first index ~5s vs ~3min (#1021). Per-collection vector partitioning (#983). NO file watching. get :from:count since 2.5.3 (2026-05-28), docid form #abc123:120:40. 2.8.3 MCP: protocol 2026-07-28 via TS SDK 2.x @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.0.0, sessionless HTTP, server/discover, Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers, 2025-era stdio clients still work.
